root_hook: Harness typed kind resume_place dispatched before base_state_hash through resume_deferred_place_run; queued stale wait does not repause after USER_RESUMED. Harness file is Root-owned.

verification.shared_file_lint: Existing whole-file Store/API lint debt was not reformatted in this scoped patch.

facts: Resume records a server-owned system message plus pending continuation in the same session-lock transaction as control revision and rebased pending authority
Durable queue item follows previously accepted paused additions; repository reopen can claim the saved queue item without model selection
resume_id and latest resume_run_id bind the continuation across independent fact revisions; superseded/completed markers do not repeat source actions
Store verifies exact indexed run/message provenance, system role, server client key and matching payload before a marker is accepted
Current deferred trip/version/scope and nested candidate/source TTL are revalidated; country source timestamps and expiry never refresh
Plaintext and button resume perform controlled source resolution after saved budget additions, without an extra model call
Expired/damaged candidate/epoch/foreigntrip data asks a fresh question and does not enqueue or execute stale source work
Foreign session calls and user-created typed markers cannot finish/copy work between sessions
Public messages hide only recognized system continuation markers; control response exposes optional resume_run_id for polling

execution.database: otravel_test only, own sessions; no schema/truncate/reset or other DB changes

remaining_boundary.fact: The existing plaintext control path commits set_control before separately completing its accepted control run. A crash in that earlier boundary can leave the plaintext control pending for recovery; the new continuation itself is already durable.
remaining_boundary.required: Atomic completion of accepted plaintext control in set_control, or a proven server-owned recovery shortcut before NLU. No claim that all distributed/worker crash outcomes are closed.
remaining_boundary.exact_trigger: Process stops after Store.set_control commits USER_RESUMED and its durable marker but before Harness.control_message separately finishes the accepted plaintext resume run; recovery may treat that pending plaintext as NLU.
remaining_boundary.closure_condition: Controlled crash exactly at the commit/finish boundary, restart, zero repeated NLU/control, preserved queued facts, one execution of current continuation, stale/expired authority rejection, and completed-control idempotence.
remaining_boundary.root_decision: Explicitly deferred to the next control-recovery checkpoint; no production expansion in this phase.

limits: No actual provider, model, full-language or frontend acceptance is implied
External read-only HTTP is not claimed exactly-once across arbitrary crashes after wire and before result persistence
Current session CAS/lease and normal place_run/catalog guards remain authoritative
Only the durable place action queue is newly qualified; existing generic resume/control lifecycle retains separately reported crash boundary
